crossRefs.note: I just want to learn this from you: Did you receive the Spirit by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?
won’t service of the Spirit be with much more glory?
Therefore they stayed there a long time, speaking boldly in the Lord, who testified to the word of his grace, granting…
He was listening to Paul speaking, who, fastening eyes on him, and seeing that he had faith to be made whole,
said with a loud voice, “Stand upright on your feet!” He leaped up and walked.
God worked special miracles by the hands of Paul,
so that even handkerchiefs or aprons were carried away from his body to the sick, and the diseases departed from them…
in the power of signs and wonders, in the power of God’s Spirit; so that from Jerusalem, and around as far as to…
I always thank my God concerning you, for the grace of God which was given you in Christ Jesus;
that in everything you were enriched in him, in all speech and all knowledge;
for the weapons of our warfare are not of the flesh, but mighty before God to the throwing down of strongholds,
Truly the signs of an apostle were worked among you in all perseverance, in signs and wonders and mighty works.
seeing that you seek a proof of Christ who speaks in me; who toward you is not weak, but is powerful in you.
I just want to learn this from you: Did you receive the Spirit by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?

translations.web: He therefore who supplies the Spirit to you and does miracles among you, does he do it by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?
translations.bsb: Does God lavish His Spirit on you and work miracles among you because you practice the law, or because you hear and believe?
translations.kjv: He therefore that ministereth to you the Spirit, and worketh miracles among you, doeth he it by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
translations.asv: He therefore that supplieth to you the Spirit, and worketh miracles among you, doeth he it by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
